top_n.title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
top_n.summary:
Paper: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
Classification: multimodal_learning
Relevant threads: Multimodal Learning, Scalable Oversight, Reasoning & Planning
Summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has become a standard post-training approach for improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing methods draw privileged information from diverse input sources to guide self-distillation. Yet these designs overlook Modality Imbalance, a challenge inherent to MLLM reasoning. top_n.title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
top_n.summary:
Paper: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
Classification: scalable_oversight
Relevant threads: Scalable Oversight, Reasoning & Planning, Multimodal Learning
Summary: Context lengths of language models (LMs) have dramatically increased, driven by the demands for in-context learning, self-improvement, and long-horizon agentic workflows. Existing long-context corpora, however, are dominated by books, academic articles, and code repositories, which are finite resources and often scarce in long-distance dependencies. top_n.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
top_n.summary:
Paper: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
Classification: reasoning_planning
Relevant threads: Reasoning & Planning, Scalable Oversight, Multimodal Learning
Summary: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified objective. We present Argus, a persistent, self-evolving runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer execute bounded missions over durable project state. top_n.title: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains

Paper: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains
Classification: multimodal_learning
Relevant threads: Multimodal Learning, Scalable Oversight, Reasoning & Planning
Summary: Modern Greek is absent from NVIDIA's Nemotron retrieval models and from major multilingual retrieval benchmarks, despite being important for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in legal, energy, financial, and medical applications.
